scope: All 347 INTERLIS 2.3/2.4 roots from the pinned official index, with frozen transitive source closure. Semantic acceptance remains subject to the explicit assessment profile.

selection.ordering: UTF-16 code unit order; source paths ascending; index root order preserved
selection.dependencyRule: Root exact model/version/file. Imported models selected by fixed point: any 2.3 importer requires 2.3; otherwise prefer 2.4, then descending lexical model version, then ascending file. Explicit source/model selections are frozen per root. All models in selected source files are available; only requested closure can issue a schema.
selection.decoding: Explicit per-file encoding with REPORT, no fallback or production loader relaxation. UTF-8 preserves BOM; windows-1252 only for original-byte pins listed below.
